  "rationale": "One DESIGN node creates every shared file up front so that the IMPLEMENT nodes can run in parallel without touching the same files. Shared files are: pom.xml (web, data-jpa, h2, data-redis, actuator/micrometer, validation), application.yml with all settings, the global exception handler and error body, the Clock bean, the Link and Click entities and repositories, the SQL schema, and the port interfaces (HostResolver, LinkCache, ClickRecorder, TokenHasher). Implementation is split by package along truly independent seams: URL safety, link creation, redirect with cache fallback, click pipeline with retention, the stats endpoint, and rate limiting. Each is well under 600 lines. Three TEST nodes are written from the criteria and the design in parallel with the code: creation/safety/rate-limit, redirect/click pipeline, and stats/retention. A JOIN merges everything and runs the full Maven build, which does not run k6. DOCS covers docs/SECURITY.md (DNS-rebinding residual risk) and the k6 load scripts. A security scan follows the join, and RELEASE_READINESS is last.",
  "nodes": [
    {
      "id": "design",
      "type": "DESIGN",
      "description": "Define the architecture and create all shared files under com.agentic.shortener. (1) pom.xml dependency changes: spring-boot-starter-web, data-jpa, validation, data-redis, actuator/micrometer, h2 (test/runtime). (2) application.yml with all settings: redis connect/read timeouts <= 50ms, click queue capacity 10000, flush interval 1s, batch size 500, max expiry 365d, rate limit 20/min, trusted-proxy off, retention 90d, stats default 30 and max 90 days, base URL. (3) Package com.agentic.shortener.common: Clock bean config (UTC); the global @RestControllerAdvice and ErrorBody {code, message}; shared exceptions with fixed HTTP mappings: InvalidUrlException and UnsafeUrlException (400, distinct error codes), InvalidRequestException (400), AliasTakenException (409), NotFoundException (404), GoneException (410), UnauthorizedException (401); TokenHasher (SHA-256 plus constant-time MessageDigest.isEqual). (4) Package com.agentic.shortener.domain: Link entity (code PK, longUrl, tokenHash, createdAt, expiresAt nullable); Click aggregate entity (linkCode, day as LocalDate UTC, referrerHost, count) with no IP, user-agent, path or timestamp columns; LinkRepository and ClickRepository with the query signatures needed by the IMPLEMENT nodes; schema.sql. (5) Port interfaces: HostResolver (resolve(host) -> List<InetAddress>, throws on failure) in com.agentic.shortener.urlsafety.api; LinkCache (get/put/evict) in com.agentic.shortener.redirect.api; ClickRecorder (non-blocking record(code, referrerHost)) in com.agentic.shortener.clicks.api. (6) Document the API contracts: POST /api/links, GET /{code}, GET /api/links/{code}/stats with X-Management-Token. Document the reserved aliases (api, actuator, health, error, static) and package ownership for each IMPLEMENT node.",
      "dependsOn": [],

      "requiresApproval": true,

    },
    {
      "id": "impl-urlsafety",
      "type": "IMPLEMENT",
      "description": "Owns package com.agentic.shortener.urlsafety only. Implement UrlSafetyValidator. It accepts only http/https, requires a host, enforces a maximum length of 2048, and rejects non-URL strings. It parses alternative IPv4 literal encodings (decimal integer, hex, octal, short forms) to canonical addresses. It resolves hostnames via HostResolver exactly once per call. It rejects with UnsafeUrlException if ANY resolved address is blocked: loopback, RFC1918 private, link-local (169.254/16, fe80::/10), CGNAT 100.64/10, unspecified 0.0.0.0 and ::, unique-local fc00::/7, and IPv4-mapped IPv6 that maps to a blocked IPv4 address. An unresolvable host is rejected with 400. Also implement DefaultHostResolver using InetAddress.getAllByName with a short timeout.",
      "dependsOn": ["design"],
      "risk": "HIGH",
      "requiresApproval": false,
      "acceptanceCriteria": ["AC7", "AC8", "AC9"]
    },
    {
      "id": "impl-link",
      "type": "IMPLEMENT",
      "description": "Owns package com.agentic.shortener.link only. Implement the POST /api/links controller and LinkCreationService. The service calls UrlSafetyValidator once per request. It validates aliases: 3-32 characters from [A-Za-z0-9_-], case-sensitive, not a reserved alias; an alias that is already taken returns 409. It validates expiresAt against the Clock: must be in the future and at most 365 days ahead; malformed values return 400. It generates 7-character base62 codes with SecureRandom and retries on collision. It generates a management token with at least 128 bits from SecureRandom, stores only the SHA-256 hash via TokenHasher, and returns the raw token only in the 201 response together with shortCode, shortUrl and expiresAt. Nothing is persisted on any error.",
      "dependsOn": ["design"],
      "risk": "HIGH",
      "requiresApproval": false,
      "acceptanceCriteria": ["AC1", "AC2", "AC3", "AC4", "AC7", "AC8", "AC9", "AC10"]
    },
    {
      "id": "impl-redirect",
      "type": "IMPLEMENT",
      "description": "Owns package com.agentic.shortener.redirect only. Implement the GET /{code} controller and RedirectService. The service reads the LinkCache first; any cache exception or timeout is logged and treated as a miss. On a miss it reads LinkRepository and populates the cache, swallowing put errors. It always checks expiry against the Clock, including for cached entries: expiresAt <= now returns 410, an unknown code returns 404, and neither response sets a Location header. Active links return 302 with Location. It extracts the Referer header and calls the non-blocking ClickRecorder inside a try/catch so that statistics can never fail a redirect. It never calls HostResolver. Also implement RedisLinkCache, the production LinkCache adapter, with timeouts taken from application.yml.",
      "dependsOn": ["design"],
      "risk": "MEDIUM",
      "requiresApproval": false,
      "acceptanceCriteria": ["AC2", "AC5", "AC6", "AC9", "AC14", "AC15", "AC16"]
    },
    {
      "id": "impl-clicks",
      "type": "IMPLEMENT",
      "description": "Owns package com.agentic.shortener.clicks only. Implement ClickRecorder as a bounded in-memory queue (capacity from config, default 10000) that uses offer() and never blocks. Normalize the referrer to a lower-cased host with no path or query; a missing referrer becomes '(direct)'. Bucket clicks by UTC day from the Clock. A background worker batch-flushes into ClickRepository aggregates every 1 s or 500 events. A full queue or a flush exception drops the events and increments a Micrometer counter for dropped clicks. Provide a test hook to trigger a flush. Implement a scheduled, idempotent RetentionJob that deletes click rows for links whose expiresAt is more than 90 days before Clock now; links without expiry are untouched.",
      "dependsOn": ["design"],
      "risk": "MEDIUM",
      "requiresApproval": false,
      "acceptanceCriteria": ["AC13", "AC14", "AC18"]
    },
    {
      "id": "impl-stats",
      "type": "IMPLEMENT",
      "description": "Owns package com.agentic.shortener.stats only. Implement GET /api/links/{code}/stats. It requires the X-Management-Token header. A missing token, a wrong token, another link's token, or an unknown code with a missing or wrong token all return 401. Comparison is constant time via TokenHasher, and an unknown code is compared against a dummy hash so that existence is not revealed. With the correct token it returns 200 with clicksPerDay as a list of {date ISO UTC, count} in ascending order over the last 30 days by default, or over ?days=1..90 (out of range returns 400). It also returns topReferrers as up to 10 {host, count} entries sorted by count descending, including '(direct)'. The raw token is never returned.",
      "dependsOn": ["design"],
      "risk": "HIGH",
      "requiresApproval": false,
      "acceptanceCriteria": ["AC11", "AC12"]
    },
    {
      "id": "impl-ratelimit",
      "type": "IMPLEMENT",
      "description": "Owns package com.agentic.shortener.ratelimit only. Implement a servlet filter that applies only to POST /api/links. It is a per-client fixed-window limiter (default 20 per minute, configurable) driven by the injectable Clock. The client key is the remote address; X-Forwarded-For is used only when the trusted-proxy setting is enabled. Requests over the limit return 429 with a Retry-After header before reaching the controller, so nothing is created. Redirect and stats paths are never limited.",
      "dependsOn": ["design"],
      "risk": "MEDIUM",
      "requiresApproval": false,
      "acceptanceCriteria": ["AC17"]
    },
    {

      "type": "TEST",

Written from the criteria and design only.",
      "dependsOn": ["design"],
      "risk": "MEDIUM",
      "requiresApproval": false,
      "acceptanceCriteria": ["AC1", "AC2", "AC3", "AC4", "AC7", "AC8", "AC9", "AC10", "AC17"]
    },
    {
      "id": "test-redirect",
      "type": "TEST",
      "description": "Write MockMvc + H2 tests in package com.agentic.shortener.redirecttests with a fixed or adjustable Clock and LinkCache test doubles. They cover: 302 with Location; 404 and 410 without Location; a throwing or timing-out cache still giving 302/410/404 from the database; an in-memory cache producing a miss then a hit with no link-table read, then 410 after the Clock passes expiry; click recording of the lower-cased referrer host only, with forwarded IP, user-agent and cookie values not persisted and no such columns; a full queue or throwing writer still giving 302 and incrementing the drop metric. Written from the criteria and design only.",
      "dependsOn": ["design"],
      "risk": "MEDIUM",
      "requiresApproval": false,
      "acceptanceCriteria": ["AC5", "AC6", "AC13", "AC14", "AC15", "AC16"]
    },
    {
      "id": "test-stats",
      "type": "TEST",
      "description": "Write MockMvc + H2 tests in package com.agentic.shortener.statstests. They cover: stats authorization (missing, wrong and other-link tokens give 401, the correct token gives 200, and an unknown code with a missing or wrong token gives 401); stats shape and counts with three UTC days and referrers a.com/b.com/c.com/(direct), default 30 days versus ?days=7, ordering and top-10 limit; and the retention job with links expired 91 days ago, expired 89 days ago, never expiring and active, verifying idempotence.       "dependsOn": ["design"],
      "risk": "MEDIUM",
      "requiresApproval": false,
      "acceptanceCriteria": ["AC11", "AC12", "AC18"]

{
  "summary": "Created the architecture for the URL shortener: design doc, security note, OpenAPI contract, service contracts (api), ports (ports.api), JPA entities and repositories (domain), error handling (common), typed configuration with a Clock bean (config), the application.yml settings and the Prometheus registry dependency. Implementers get exact package ownership, fully qualified class names, constructor dependencies and the table and column names the schema task must create; no Flyway migrations are added here.",
  "edits": [
    {
      "path": "pom.xml",
      "action": "patch",
      "search": "            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-actuator</artifactId>
        </dependency>",
      "replace": "            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-actuator</artifactId>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>io.micrometer</groupId>
            <artifactId>micrometer-registry-prometheus</artifactId>
            <scope>runtime</scope>
        </dependency>"
    },
    {
      "path": "src/main/resources/application.yml",
      "action": "replace",
      "content": "spring:
  application:
    name: shortener
  datasource:
    url: ${DB_URL:jdbc:postgresql://localhost:5432/shortener}
    username: ${DB_USER:shortener}
    password: ${DB_PASSWORD:shortener}
  data:
    redis:
      host: ${REDIS_HOST:localhost}
      port: ${REDIS_PORT:6379}
      connect-timeout: 50ms
      timeout: 50ms
  flyway:
    enabled: true
  jpa:
    open-in-view: false
    hibernate:
      ddl-auto: validate
  jackson:
    serialization:
      write-dates-as-timestamps: false

shortener:
  base-url: ${SHORTENER_BASE_URL:http://localhost:8080}
  links:
    code-length: 7
    max-expiry: 365d
    max-url-length: 2048
    max-code-attempts: 10
    reserved-aliases: [api, actuator, health, error, static]
  dns:
    resolve-timeout: 2s
  cache:
    enabled: true
    ttl: 1h
    key-prefix: "link:"
  click-queue:
    capacity: 10000
    flush-interval: 1s
    batch-size: 500
  rate-limit:
    requests-per-window: 20
    window: 1m
    trust-forwarded-for: false
  stats:
    default-days: 30
    max-days: 90
    top-referrers: 10
  retention:
    after-expiry: 90d
    cron: "0 30 3 * * *"

management:
  health:
    redis:
      enabled: false
  endpoints:

      "content": "# URL Shortener: Design

Base package `com.agentic.shortener`. Spring Boot 3.4, JPA, Flyway, Redis (cache only), Micrometer.

## Components
- **Creation** (`POST /api/links`): rate limit, then validate alias, expiry and URL safety, then generate a code and token and persist. Returns 201 `CreateLinkResponse`.
- **Redirect** (`GET /{code}`): LinkCache, falling back to the DB on a miss. Expiry is checked against the Clock. The click is enqueued and the response is a 302.
- **Stats** (`GET /api/links/{code}/stats`): token check first, then daily totals and top referrers.
- **Click pipeline**: a bounded in-memory queue and a scheduled batch flush that upserts aggregate rows.
- **Retention**: a cron job deletes click rows of links that expired at least 90 days ago.

## Shared files (owned by DESIGN; implementers must not edit)
- `config.ShortenerConfiguration`: `@EnableScheduling`, a `Clock` bean (`Clock.systemUTC()`), and binding of `config.ShortenerProperties` (prefix `shortener`; every value has a default).
- `common.ErrorCode`, `common.ErrorBody(code, message)`, `common.ApiException(ErrorCode, String)`, `common.RateLimitedException(long retryAfterSeconds)`, `common.GlobalExceptionHandler`.
- `api.*`: service contracts and DTOs. `ports.api.*`: ports. `domain.*`: entities and repositories.

## Error mapping (body is always `ErrorBody`)
| Code | HTTP | When |
|---|---|---|
| INVALID_URL | 400 | blank, >2048 chars, not http/https, no host, has userinfo, unparseable, unresolvable host |
| UNSAFE_URL | 400 | any resolved or literal address is blocked |
| INVALID_ALIAS | 400 | not 3-32 chars of [A-Za-z0-9_-], or reserved (case-insensitive) |
| ALIAS_TAKEN | 409 | alias already exists |
| INVALID_EXPIRY | 400 | unparseable, <= now, or > now + max-expiry |
| INVALID_REQUEST | 400 | malformed JSON, type mismatch, `days` outside 1..max-days |
| UNAUTHORIZED | 401 | stats token missing or wrong, or unknown code |
| NOT_FOUND / GONE | 404 / 410 | unknown or expired code on redirect (no Location header) |
| RATE_LIMITED | 429 | creation over limit; the handler adds `Retry-After` seconds |

Bean-validation field errors map by field: `url` to INVALID_URL, `alias` to INVALID_ALIAS, `expiresAt` to INVALID_EXPIRY, anything else to INVALID_REQUEST.

## Data model (exact names; SCHEMA must match JPA `ddl-auto=validate`)
Table `links`:
- `id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY`
- `code VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL UNIQUE` (unique constraint `uk_links_code`)
- `long_url VARCHAR(2048) NOT NULL`
- `token_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL` (lower-case hex SHA-256 of the UTF-8 token)
- `created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL`
- `expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NULL`, with index `ix_links_expires_at`

Table `clicks` (aggregates only; no IP, user-agent, URL path or timestamp column):
- `id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY`
- `link_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES links(id) ON DELETE CASCADE`
- `click_day DATE NOT NULL` (UTC day)
- `referrer_host VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL` (`(direct)` when there is no referrer)
- `click_count BIGINT NOT NULL`
- unique constraint `uk_clicks_link_day_host (link_id, click_day, referrer_host)`

JPA field names: `Link{id, code, longUrl, tokenHash, createdAt, expiresAt}` and `Click{id, linkId, clickDay, referrerHost, clickCount}`. `Click` getters are `getDay()` and `getCount()`. Construct with `new Link(code, longUrl, tokenHash, createdAt, expiresAt)` and `new Click(linkId, day, referrerHost, count)`.

## Implementation tasks and ownership
Every class is a Spring bean with constructor injection, unless noted otherwise.

**SCHEMA** owns `src/main/resources/db/migration/V1__create_links_and_clicks.sql`. Use portable SQL that runs on H2 and PostgreSQL.

**SAFETY** owns `com.agentic.shortener.safety`.
- `safety.DnsHostResolver implements HostResolver` (`@Component`; ctor `(ShortenerProperties)`). Calls `InetAddress.getAllByName` on a virtual thread and bounds the wait with `dns.resolve-timeout`.
- `safety.DefaultUrlSafetyValidator implements UrlSafetyValidator` (`@Component`; ctor `(HostResolver, ShortenerProperties)`).
- Rules: trim the input; length must be <= max-url-length; parse with `java.net.URI`; scheme must be http or https; reject userinfo. Take the host from `getHost()`, or from `getRawAuthority()` minus the port when `getHost()` is null (URI returns null for numeric hosts such as `2130706433` or `0x7f.1`). Lower-case the host and strip brackets and any trailing dot.
- IP literals (IPv6, or IPv4 in inet_aton form: 1-4 parts, each decimal, `0x` hex or `0` octal) are checked locally and the resolver is NOT called. A host whose last label is numeric but not a valid literal is INVALID_URL.
- Other hosts call `HostResolver.resolve` exactly once. An exception or empty list is INVALID_URL. Any blocked address is UNSAFE_URL.
- Blocked IPv4: 0/8, 10/8, 100.64/10, 127/8, 169.254/16, 172.16/12, 192.0.0/24, 192.168/16, 198.18/15, 224/4, 240/4.
- Blocked IPv6: ::, ::1, fc00::/7, fe80::/10, ff00::/8. For IPv4-mapped (::ffff:0:0/96), IPv4-compatible and NAT64 64:ff9b::/96 addresses, check the embedded IPv4 address.

**LINKS** owns `com.agentic.shortener.links`.
- `links.LinkController`: `POST /api/links` with `@Valid @RequestBody CreateLinkRequest`. Calls `CreationRateLimiter.checkAllowed(request.getRemoteAddr(), header X-Forwarded-For)` first, then `LinkService.create`, and returns 201.
- The same controller serves `GET /api/links/{code}/stats`: header
